name: paradocs
description: Paragon Knowledge MCP, ParaDOCS convert tooling, and authoring rules for tech writers.

PARAGON_CURSOR_DOCS_ROOT.title: Cursor guides repo root
PARAGON_CURSOR_DOCS_ROOT.description: Local path to the Cursor guides repository (cursor-test or equivalent).

PARAGON_PARADOCS_REPO.title: Technical Documentation repo root
PARAGON_PARADOCS_REPO.description: Local path to the Technical Documentation repository that contains corpus/ folders.

PARAGON_CURSOR_CORPORA.title: Extra corpora (optional)
PARAGON_CURSOR_CORPORA.description: Semicolon-separated id=path pairs for additional corpora, e.g. tech-arch=C:/path/corpus/tech-arch;abbey-view=C:/path/corpus/abbey-view.

PARAGON_TECH_ARCH_SOURCE.title: Tech-arch SharePoint source (optional)
PARAGON_TECH_ARCH_SOURCE.description: SharePoint sync root for convert/OCR scripts only; not required for read/search MCP tools.

PARAGON_TECH_ARCH_CORPUS.title: Tech-arch corpus output (optional)
PARAGON_TECH_ARCH_CORPUS.description: Markdown output folder for convert/OCR scripts only.
